_comment: What an Age's abyss will not carry. Living things, and nothing else -- design 7.1.2's deep water is a
crushing lightless place and a kelp forest at eighty metres in the dark is not a thing.
**Inorganic stays** (Jonah, 2026-09-10): an ocean monument, a shipwreck, ruins, prismarine and sea
lanterns are all wanted down there, and are conspicuously absent from this list. What goes is the
vegetation that grew in the water those structures brought with them.
A tag rather than a list in code, so a pack adding an aquatic plant can keep it out without a jar.
